object.description: Open VCU3-SRS of the req-test fixture. Select VCU3-SRS-1. Expected: the Inspector shows its description, which holds FAULT_OVERTEMP, and its outgoing link to VCU3-SyRS-42. Select VCU3-SRS-10. Expected: the Inspector shows its description, which holds MISRA. Give VCU3-SRS-2 an empty status on disk, reload and select it. Expected: the Inspector's status shows no value, not the first option. With VCU3-SRS-15 selected, change its description from the grid. Expected: the Inspector shows the new text, and an edit of another object leaves it. With no object selected, the Inspector shows its empty state.
